                  Filter.atTop (nhds 1) →

  P = RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pathGraphMixture ρ →

      0 ≤ ε →
        (∀ (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N),
            good G →
              1 - ε ≤
                RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
                  A (RiffleLowerV2.componentSort G π)) →
          RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) A ≤ η →

  ∀ {N : ℕ} (H0 : Finset ℤ) (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) {D δ : ℝ},
    0 < ↑H0.card →
      576 ≤ ↑H0.card ^ δ →
        24 * D ≤ ↑H0.card ^ δ →
          (∀ (q : Fin (N + 1)), ↑(RiffleLowerV2.boundary (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N H0 ↑↑q)).card ≤ D * √↑H0.card) →
            (∃ (q : Fin (N + 1)),
                ↑(Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N H0 ↑↑q))) ≥
                  ↑H0.card ^ (1 / 2 + δ)) →
              1 - Real.exp (-↑H0.card ^ (2 * δ) / 144) ≤
                RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
                  RiffleLowerV2.scan H0 (↑H0.card ^ (1 / 2 + δ / 2)) (RiffleLowerV2.componentSort G π)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_componentEdges..type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (j : ℕ) (e : Fin (N - 1)),

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_componentSet.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_componentSet
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_componentSet.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries..name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries._simp_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries..type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)) (e : Fin (N - 1)),
  (e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries G H) =
    (e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries G H ∧
      RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent G e ⊆ H ∧ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.rightComponent G e ⊆ H)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries..name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries._simp_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries..type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s t : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ s \ t) = (a ∈ s ∧ a ∉ t)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries..name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries._simp_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries..type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s t : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ s ∪ t) = (a ∈ s ∨ a ∈ t)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries..type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ Finset.filter p s) = (a ∈ s ∧ p a)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_retainedBoundar.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_retainedBoundaries
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_retainedBoundar.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)) (e : Fin (N - 1)),
  e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries G H ↔ e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H ∧ e ∉ G

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_retainedBoundar.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_retainedBoundaries._simp_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_retainedBoundar.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)) (e : Fin (N - 1)),

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_successfulTrans.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_successfulTranslates._simp_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_successfulTrans.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (H0 : Finset ℤ) (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (r : ℝ) (q : Fin (N + 1)),

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.null_scan_envelope_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.null_scan_envelope_tendsto_zero
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.null_scan_envelope_.type: ∀ {β : ℝ}, 0 < β → Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => (↑N + 1) * Real.exp (-↑N ^ β)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.one_class_mgf.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.one_class_mgf
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.one_class_mgf.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] {I : Type u_2} (P : PMF Ω) (s : Finset I) (A : I → Ω → Prop),
  (∀ (u : ℝ),
      (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
          ∏ i ∈ s, Real.exp (u * ((if A i ω then 1 else 0) - RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)))) =
        ∏ i ∈ s,
          RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
            Real.exp (u * ((if A i ω then 1 else 0) - RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)))) →
    ∀ (u : ℝ),
      (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
          Real.exp (u * ∑ i ∈ s, ((if A i ω then 1 else 0) - RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)))) ≤
        Real.exp (u ^ 2 * ↑s.card / 8)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.orderTransform.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.orderTransform
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.orderTransform.type: {n : ℕ} → Equiv.Perm (Fin n) → Equiv.Perm (Fin n) ≃ Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.orderTransform._pro.type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (ρ η : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)), (Equiv.trans ρ (Equiv.symm η)).symm.trans ρ = η

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.orderTransform._pro.type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (ρ η : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)), Equiv.trans ρ ((Equiv.symm η).trans ρ).symm = η

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets.value: fun {N : ℕ} (A B : Finset (Fin N)) (b : Bool) => if b = true then B else A

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets_disjoint._.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : PartialOrder α] [inst_1 : OrderBot α] {a b : α}, Disjoint a b = Disjoint b a

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.parity_mgf.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.parity_mgf._simp_1_.type: ∀ (x y : ℝ), Real.exp x * Real.exp y = Real.exp (x + y)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_and_rel.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_and_relativeOrder
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_and_rel.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (A : I → Finset (Fin N))
  (hA : ∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j)) (S : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N → Prop),
  (∀ (η : (i : I) → Equiv.Perm (Fin (A i).card)) (π : Fin N ≃ Fin N),
      S (Equiv.trans (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockAction A hA η) π) ↔ S π) →
    ∀ (τ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
      (RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
          S π ∧ ∀ (i : I), RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder (A i) π = RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder (A i) τ) =
        RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) S * ∏ i : I, 1 / ↑(A i).card.factorial

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_and_rel.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_and_relativeOrder._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_and_rel.type: ∀ {α : Sort u} {β : α → Sort v} {f g : (x : α) → β x}, (f = g) = ∀ (x : α), f x = g x

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_false.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_false
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_false.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω), (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (x : Ω) => False) = 0

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_iUnion_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_iUnion_le
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_iUnion_.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] {I : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Fintype I] (P : PMF Ω) (A : I → Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => ∃ (i : I), A i ω) ≤ ∑ i : I, RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_le_one.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_le_one
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_le_one.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop), RiffleLowerV2.probability P A ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_mono.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_mono
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_mono.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) {A B : Ω → Prop},
  (∀ (ω : Ω), A ω → B ω) → RiffleLowerV2.probability P A ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P B

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_nonneg.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_nonneg.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop), 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P A

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_not.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_not
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_not.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => ¬A ω) = 1 - RiffleLowerV2.probability P A

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_pathGra.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_pathGraphMixture
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_pathGra.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (ρ : PMF (RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N)) (A : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N → Prop),
  RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pathGraphMixture ρ) A =
    RiffleLowerV2.expect ρ fun (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) =>
      RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
        A (RiffleLowerV2.componentSort G π)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_relativ.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_relativeOrder
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_relativ.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin N)) (τ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
      ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, π x < π y ↔ τ x < τ y) =
    1 / ↑A.card.factorial

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_relativ.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_relativeOrder._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_relativ.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin N)) (π σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder A π = RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder A σ) =
    ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, π x < π y ↔ σ x < σ y

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_sub_le_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_sub_le_tv
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_sub_le_.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_true.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω), (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (x : Ω) => True) = 1

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_uniform.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_uniform_ascent
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_uniform.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (i j : Fin N),
  i ≠ j →
    (RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
        π i < π j) =
      1 / 2

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_union_l.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_union_le
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_union_l.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A B : Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A ω ∨ B ω) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P A + RiffleLowerV2.probability P B

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.quantitative_compon.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.quantitative_component_failure
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.quantitative_compon.type:
RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ComponentComparison →
  ∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)) {M D δ : ℝ},
    0 < M →
      ↑H.card ≤ M →
        576 ≤ M ^ δ →
          24 * D ≤ M ^ δ →
            M ^ (1 / 2 + δ) ≤ ↑(Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H)) →
              ↑(RiffleLowerV2.boundary H).card ≤ D * √M →
                (RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
                    ↑(RiffleLowerV2.ascentCount H (RiffleLowerV2.componentSort G π)) ≤
                      ↑(Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H)) / 2 + M ^ (1 / 2 + δ / 2)) ≤
                  Real.exp (-M ^ (2 * δ) / 144)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.realizeRelativeOrde.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.realizeRelativeOrder
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.realizeRelativeOrde.type: {N : ℕ} → (A : Finset (Fin N)) → Equiv.Perm (Fin A.card) → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N

    Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries G H) + Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badBoundaries G H) =

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.subgaussian_tails.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.subgaussian_tails
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.subgaussian_tails.type:

        (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => t ≤ X ω) ≤ Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / B) ∧
          (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => X ω ≤ -t) ≤ Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / B)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.two_class_indicator.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.two_class_indicator_concentration
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.two_class_indicator.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] {I : Type u_2} (P : PMF Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (s₀ s₁ : Finset I)
  (A : I → Ω → Prop),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), X ω = (c + ∑ i ∈ s₀, if A i ω then 1 else 0) + ∑ i ∈ s₁, if A i ω then 1 else 0) →
    (∀ (u : ℝ),
        (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
            ∏ i ∈ s₀, Real.exp (u * ((if A i ω then 1 else 0) - RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)))) =
          ∏ i ∈ s₀,
            RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
              Real.exp (u * ((if A i ω then 1 else 0) - RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)))) →
      (∀ (u : ℝ),
          (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
              ∏ i ∈ s₁, Real.exp (u * ((if A i ω then 1 else 0) - RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)))) =
            ∏ i ∈ s₁,
              RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
                Real.exp (u * ((if A i ω then 1 else 0) - RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)))) →
        ∀ {M t : ℝ},
          0 < M →
            ↑s₀.card + ↑s₁.card ≤ M →
              0 < t →
                (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => t ≤ X ω - RiffleLowerV2.expect P X) ≤
                    Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / M) ∧
                  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => X ω - RiffleLowerV2.expect P X ≤ -t) ≤
                    Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / M)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.two_class_indicator.type: ∀ {I : Type u_1} (s₀ s₁ : Finset I), s₀.card + s₁.card = 0 → ¬s₀.card = 0 → False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.two_class_indicator.type: ∀ {I : Type u_1} (s₀ s₁ : Finset I), s₀.card + s₁.card = 0 → ¬s₁.card = 0 → False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.uniform_null_scan_b.type:
RiffleLowerV2.Targets.UniformScan →
  ∀ {N : ℕ},
    0 < N →
      ∀ (H0 : Finset ℤ) {a δ : ℝ},
        0 < a →
          0 < δ →
            ↑N ^ a ≤ ↑H0.card →
              RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N)
                  (RiffleLowerV2.scan H0 (↑H0.card ^ (1 / 2 + δ / 2))) ≤
                (↑N + 1) * Real.exp (-↑N ^ (a * δ))

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.uniform_null_scan_e.type:

    0 < a →
      0 < δ →
        0 < ε →
          ∃ (N0 : ℕ),

              ∀ N ≥ N0,
                ∀ (H0 : Finset ℤ),
                  ↑N ^ a ≤ ↑H0.card →
                    RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N)
                        (RiffleLowerV2.scan H0 (↑H0.card ^ (1 / 2 + δ / 2))) ≤
                      ε

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.uniform_null_scan_e.type: ∀ (n0 N : ℕ), N ≥ max n0 1 → ¬0 < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.uniform_probability.type:
